summary: Tracked armour breaks house walls as the hull reaches them. The roof comes down, leaving rubble and a passable floor. Bridge parapets stop the hull.
stage: Native Godot 4.7.2, trenches, seed 3, high preset, golden lighting, fixed 30 fps. Same house, camera and fixed route, 192 ticks after the tank starts.
rationale: After the same tank crosses the house, the roof used to remain over the missing walls. Now the opening and rubble show where the tank went through.
source_ref: Main afe46c41 compared with the same revision plus this change.
